digest.component_or_area: scripts/gen_env_registry.py environment-helper registry and config-ownership gate
propositions: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table rows with no matching def/async def under src/rebar scan root are never validated, leaving 4 ghost rows (_rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) in the registry that match nothing in the tree
Ghost rows silently exempt unowned env reads from the config-ownership gate, allowing calls like _int_pref('SOME_KNOB') to pass with zero findings despite matching no real function
The held-out config-ownership test depends on dict insertion order to select _rebar_env at position 0, making a ghost row the load-bearing prerequisite for test passage

A rename without table re-keying (e.g. deleting _str_pref and introducing _gate_str_pref in 269b4d5678) produces a ghost row, silently dropping REBAR_GATE_REF/REBAR_GATE_SOURCE from docs/env-vars.md until discovered by manual census
Fail-closed validation must be root-independent to avoid false positives on synthetic scan roots used in 11 test cases where 13 of 13 rows appear stale against a one-module tree
